data.description:
## Description

What: New plugins/dso/scripts/pr-owned-by-session.sh <pr-number> that calls 'gh pr view --json body', parses the Session-Id: trailer, compares to $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, and exits 0 (own), 1 (foreign), 2 (absent), 3 (api_error), with structured stderr identifying the case. Why: The wrapper and any future caller need a pure, side-effect-free ownership classifier. Scope IN: the four-exit-code classification; structured stderr per case; a shell unit test covering all 4 exits with synthetic fixtures; an explicit guarantee that the helper never invokes a destructive gh pr action. Scope OUT: executing destructive actions (that is the wrapper, draft-4); trailer stamping (draft-2).


## Done Definitions

- pr-owned-by-session.sh <pr-number> exits 0 when the parsed Session-Id trailer equals $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, 1 when it differs (foreign), 2 when no trailer is present (absent), and 3 when gh pr view fails (api_error), each with structured stderr naming the case ← Satisfies: sc-2
- A shell unit test covers all four exit codes using synthetic gh-pr-view body fixtures ← Satisfies: sc-2
- The helper never invokes gh pr close/merge/edit/comment, verified by a test asserting no destructive gh pr subcommand is reachable from any code path ← Satisfies: sc-2

## Considerations

- [Multi-agent] 0777-0f3d: the helper returns 0 (own) for all agents sharing the same CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID — document this same-session-actors behavior explicitly in the helper header.
- [FailClosed] Distinguish exit 2 (absent) from exit 3 (api_error) precisely; a body approaching the GitHub 65k truncation limit at create should be treated as absent (fail-closed) per the epic MEDIUM scenario.
- [Parsing] gh pr view --json body may normalize/strip the trailer — fixtures must include a GitHub-API-returned body shape, not just a hand-built one.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO session, I want a pr-owned-by-session.sh helper that classifies a PR's ownership by reading its Session-Id trailer, so that any caller can determine own/foreign/absent/api_error without itself performing a destructive action.
